Carpentry Overview
Carpentry
is the skill of wood working, it is used to craft chairs, some weapons, and food accessories.
If you plan on gathering wood yourself, you'll need to buy a
Handsaw
from a vendor such as
Therese
in
Serbule
town. Alternatively, players of a high level may encounter a
Cutting Blade Necklace
, an amulet slot item that also works as a handsaw.
Note:
Under no circumstances can any regular animal beast-form gather wood from regular tree-falls, not even with the
Cutting Blade Necklace
. Birds can, but only if they are humanoid under the
Druid
illusion. For animals, the only options are to use alternate humanoid characters to gather wood, buy it from players, break it down from
Treant Wood
loot, or barter with
Gretchen Salas
. Alternatively, you might find it in NPC Used Item tabs or you can try posting player work orders.
In-Game Description
Preparing and treating lumber, and making things out of wood.
Training Carpentry
Jara
in
Serbule
will teach
Carpentry
to those who help her with a
bear problem
. She teaches most basic recipes for Carpentry.
Lawara
on
Anagoge
gives
Carpentry
XP when the hangout
Help carve marionettes
is completed.
Paul Vaughn
in
Serbule Hills
teaches basic calligraphy bench recipes and a few other recipes.
The Wombat
in
Sun Vale
can teach several recipes. Wooden Melee Staffs, Combat Staffs, and Wooden shoes for Cows and Deer can be learned from him.
Lamashu
in the
Kur Mountains
teaches recipes for Storage Crates. She also teaches the combat abilities in the Stake the Heart set.
Ufkar
in
Rahu
teaches the recipes for
Battle Chemistry
staves.
Amutasa
, a toolmaker in
Rahu
, can raise the skill cap for
Carpentry
from 51-60 and 61-70.
Solgribue
unlocks 71-80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Dunahain Broadarm
deep beneath
Povus
.
